flaws.title: Product names inserted as HTML
flaws.why: row.innerHTML = product.name renders catalog data as markup, so a product name with a script runs in every buyer's browser and can read the session token.

flaws.title: Session token kept in localStorage
flaws.why: saveSession puts the token in localStorage, where any script on the page (such as the search XSS) can read and steal it; an HttpOnly cookie would not be readable.

flaws.title: Search text not URL-encoded
flaws.why: query is put into `/catalog/search?q=${query}` raw, so text with &, # or + breaks the search or adds extra parameters.

flaws.title: Checkout ignores failed responses and allows double submit
flaws.why: placeOrder never checks response.ok and has no guard or idempotency key, so an error looks like success (or json() throws) and a second click places a second order.

flaws.title: Search results pile up and race
flaws.why: showResults appends to list without clearing it and does not cancel earlier calls, so results from old searches stay and can arrive after newer ones; response.ok is also not checked.
